text:
Type: wool medallion runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside path; bedroom, living room, entryway
Style: traditional, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: hand-tufted wool, raised textured pile, tasseled ends
Colors: taupe, cream, grey, charcoal
Shape: long narrow runner, diamond medallions with scrolling floral motifs, carved texture, tassels on ends
Feel: soft, muted, cozy
Goes with: warm wood floors, navy cabinetry, brass hardware; farmhouse or traditional rooms

product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Stunning dark green and blue medallions highlighted by a cream background and tassled ends create a sophisticated look. This runner is ideal for freshening up any transitional or contemporary room that needs a punch of elegant color and pattern. 2'6" x 8' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
